g1.label: 1. How long do placements last?
g1.why: The recording says placements last between four and twelve weeks.

g2.label: 2. What are the two main project types?
g2.why: The recording says most volunteers help with wildlife conservation or teaching English.

g3.label: 3. What does the fee cover?
g3.why: The recording says the fee covers accommodation and two meals a day.

g4.label: 4. Budget for flights?
g4.why: The recording says to budget around six hundred pounds for flights.

g5.label: 5. When do applications close?
g5.why: The recording says applications close at the end of March.

g6.label: 6. What is Isla worried about?
g6.why: The recording says Isla isn't sure she could afford the flights.

g7.label: 7. What could help with costs?
g7.why: The recording says a small grant from the school could help with costs.

g8.label: 8. Which project does Isla want?
g8.why: The recording says Isla prefers teaching in Vietnam because she wants to be a teacher.

g1.label: 1. Grace — loves animals, outdoors
g1.why: The text says the Wildlife Conservation project protects endangered animals.

g2.label: 2. Liam — wants to teach, loves children
g2.why: The text says the Teaching English project supports local teachers.

g3.label: 3. Priya — ocean and marine life
g3.why: The text says the Turtle Conservation project protects sea turtle nests.

g4.label: 4. Ahmed — hands-on building work
g4.why: The text says the Community Building project helps build a community centre.

g5.label: 5. Flights included in fee
g5.why: The text says flights are not included in the programme fee.

g6.label: 6. Two meals a day included
g6.why: The text confirms volunteers receive two meals a day as part of the fee.

g7.label: 7. Applications any time of year
g7.why: The text says applications open in January and close at the end of March.

g8.label: 8. Longest placement is twelve weeks
g8.why: The text confirms the longest placement available is twelve weeks.
